question: Should esp-openclaw-node expose registered scopes as a public API/config surface now, and what exact serialization and validation contract should that API use?
rationale: The branch adds authorization-affecting public API and Kconfig surface; automation can identify the divergence bug, but it cannot choose the permanent scope contract for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow scope API
options.body: Accept the direction only after the branch uses canonical scope serialization, validates or bounds inputs, adds tests, and provides real device proof.

options.title: Defer scope support
options.body: Keep current main's empty scopes behavior until the OpenClaw protocol and ESP component API contract are confirmed.

options.title: Replace with a different contract
options.body: Ask for a new PR using a maintainer-chosen shape such as config-time scopes or a stricter typed scope list.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow scope API
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only after the branch uses canonical scope serialization, validates or bounds inputs, adds tests, and provides real device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current protocol, registry, and auth-payload implementation that this public scope API would extend.
